newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher on Tuesday NCDs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher on Tuesday NCDs.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Wednesday as market liquidity remained tight following the central bank's issue of T$10 billion negotiable certificates of deposit on Tuesday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.026 percent against Tuesday's 5.862 close -- above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.15-6.25 percent against 5.55-6.00.
Dealers said they expected the rates to stabilise on Thursday on the scheduled maturation of T$5 billion NCDs.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8365 percent against 5.8325.
